description: Change of use from offices (B1) to a proposed secondary school (non-residential education use Class D1)  along with replacement enclosed external fire escape.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numberedLetter Noise Assessment from Barnsley Hewett and Mallinson, Sustainability and Energy Efficiency Statement, Transport Statement (Including Travel Plan Framework), Design and Access Statement, Flood Report, 2630-L004, 2630-B020, 2630-S010, 2630-S011, 2630-S012, 2630-S013, 2630-B021, 2630-B010, 2630-B011, 2630-B012, 2630-B013, 2630-L001, Received 20 February 2012, Technical Note (Transport), Viability Assessment, Received 4 April 2012, Letter MacDonald Planning Consultancy, Received 29 May 2012, Air Quality Assessment, Planning Noise Assessment, Received 8 June 2012, 2630-B001, Received 7 November 2012 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No development shall commence until a full energy statement has been produced showing how the building can meet with London Plan policy 5.2 targets with a 25% reduction in carbon dioxide emissions on the 2010 Building Regulations. The agreed measures to meet this target will be implemented prior to occupation of the building for education use.

Condition : 5 - No development shall commence until detailed air quality dispersion modelling report has been submitted and suitable and reasonable mitigation measures have been agreed. The approved details shall be implemented prior to the occupation of the building and shall be maintained thereafter.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until full details of a soft landscaping scheme have been submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and these works should be carried out as approved. These details shall include a planting plan, written specifications, schedules of plants, plant sizes and species and proposed numbers and densities. The scheme shall provide additional planting within the outdoor play area on the site. The scheme shall detail maintenance and replacement planting as necessary. 

The details shall be carried out as approved prior to the occupation of the building and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 7 - Before first occupation of the building, a detailed scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sounds (including internal plant noise) shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. This shall be generally in accordance with the Planning Noise Assessment, Received 8 June 2012, and shall provide further detailed calculations following detailed design and layout of the proposed used. 

The scheme shall be carried out as agreed prior to the occupation of the development.
Condition : 8 - The development shall not commence until the scheme to provide for 'School - Keep Clear' markings on Capital Interchange Way have been completed.

Condition : 9 - No development shall take place until details have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority for a construction management plan and construction logistics plan. The works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details. 
These plans should provide details on the likely highway and traffic impact to the TLRN.
Condition : 10 - No ball games or sports shall be played in the outdoor play area of the site.

Condition : 11 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 and (Amendment) Order 2010 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no new buildings, extensions, or alterations to surfacing shall be erected or carried out.

Condition : 12 - The premises shall be used for a Secondary School only and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning Use Classes Order 2010, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 13 - Following the cessation of the hereby permitted D1 use of the site, its use shall revert to a B1(a) office use class.

Condition : 14 - Prior to the occupation of the building the parking spaces at ground level (bus parking, visitor parking and disabled spaces) shall be marked out in accordance with the Site Plan 2630-L001, and shall be permanently available for parking and not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 15 - Access to and from the premises (including pedestrians) shall be from Capital Interchange Way only and shall not be from Chiswick High Road.

Condition : 16 - No development shall take place until a scheme indicating the provision for disabled people to access the building shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall be implemented prior to the occupation of the building and maintained thereafter for the lifetime of the development.
